name: Magnitogorsk

queries.query: Magnitogorsk official cadastral map public parcel map Rosreestr Magnitogorsk land plots
queries.result: Results identified the official Magnitogorsk municipal GIS portal, Rosreestr/National Spatial Data public cadastral-map references, and a municipal land-auction procedure referring users to the city GIS portal. No currently usable anonymous parcel ID-plus-geometry endpoint was exposed in discovery.

queries.query: Магнитогорск официальная кадастровая карта публичная карта земельные участки Росреестр геопортал
queries.result: Russian-language discovery identified the official municipal GIS portal as a city spatial-data portal publishing administration GIS data, land-auction information and planning zones; official/first-party references also direct users to the Rosreestr public cadastral map. No usable anonymous parcel geometry response was obtained.

freshResearch.method: Web discovery followed by bounded public GET/REST probes. No credentials, private tokens, login, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, unsafe fields or owner/titleholder data were requested. TLS verification was retained for the decisive retry; an earlier diagnostic fetch used curl -k after the portal's certificate error and is explicitly not treated as qualification evidence.

portalsFound.observation: Official municipal GIS portal about page describes publication of spatial data used by Magnitogorsk administration, including land auctions, advertising structures, construction permits and planning-regulation zones. It establishes a local municipal GIS custodian, but the public page does not expose a parcel layer schema or API response.
Local report describes the Magnitogorsk GIS portal and its administration GIS content; it is corroborating context, not a parcel service response.
Official city administration domain was identified in Russian-language discovery; no parcel geometry endpoint was exposed in the bounded inspection.

requests.assessment: Portal HTML returned over HTTPS, but the certificate chain failed local TLS verification. The HTML exposed a JavaScript loader but not the viewer configuration or service URL.

TLS-verified request failed with certificate verification error; no script/configuration evidence was accepted. A prior curl -k diagnostic fetch was made, but is excluded from evidence and did not qualify a source.

Public ArcGIS parcel-layer point query at the exact WUP coordinate, requesting only OBJECTID, CAD_NUM and geometry, timed out. The service is a general Rosreestr-derived layer hosted by Novosibirsk regional infrastructure, not a verified Magnitogorsk local custodian; no hit/miss inference was made.
Legacy Rosreestr ArcGIS service probe did not return a usable response within the bounded attempt. No geometry or schema was retained.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Magnitogorsk municipal territory, Chelyabinsk Oblast, Russian Federation.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: Municipal GIS custodian and public cadastral-map procedure references only; no anonymous parcel geometry coverage verified.

remainingUncertainty: The current municipal viewer's JavaScript/configuration, parcel layer endpoint, schema, CRS, stable native parcel identity, update currency and citywide coverage remain unresolved. The exact WUP point was preserved and never shifted. A timeout, certificate/login/UI failure or unavailable map is not evidence of citywide cadastral absence.
nextStep: A later attempt may inspect the municipal portal with a trusted certificate chain or a newly exposed public API, then issue only a bounded anonymous ID-plus-geometry request. Runtime integration remains held pending independent serial qualification.
